name: upload_heldout
notes: Upload held-out set (eval/upload_heldout.jsonl), run once with final settings at the time, before referrals and OCR-tolerant verification. Its one unverified answer (u4-docref) used the old first-sentence fallback. Saved after the run from its outputs; settings were not snapshotted at run time (see the source run's summary.json for the retriever, top_k and gate it used). Metrics are recomputed from the rows.
